# Engage

Engage turns your customers into fans with personalised messaging; using emails, push and in-app notifications, and SMS.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/engage/.

## Actions

- **Add Customer to Accounts**: Add a customer to one or more account entities.
- **Add User to Lists**: Add a Customer or Account to one or more Lists in Engage.so.
- **Archive List**: Archive a List in Engage.
- **Create User**: Create a new user (Customer or Account) in Engage.
- **Delete User**: Completely delete all user data for a Customer or Account.
- **Get List** (read-only): Retrieve a single List by its ID.
- **Get User By ID** (read-only): Retrieve a single user by their user ID.
- **List Lists** (read-only): Retrieve a paginated list of all Lists in Engage.
- **List Users** (read-only): Retrieve a paginated list of all users in Engage.
- **Subscribe User to List**: Create a user and subscribe them to an Engage.so List.
- **Archive User**: Archive a user in Engage.
- **Batch Request**: Batch multiple create user, update user, and add user events operations into a single API call.
- **Convert User Type**: Convert a user between Customer and Account entity types.
- **Create List**: Create a new List in Engage for organizing subscribers.
- **Delete Subscriber From List**: Remove a subscriber from a List entirely (different from unsubscribing).
- **Get Account Members** (read-only): Retrieve all members (Customers) of an Account in Engage.
- **Merge Users**: Merge two user profiles in Engage.
- **Remove Customer from Account**: Remove a Customer from an Account in Engage.
- **Track User Event**: Add user events to Engage.
- **Update Account Role**: Update the role of a Customer in an Account or set a new one if none exists.
- **Update Subscriber Status**: Update a subscriber's status on a List.
- **Update User**: Update user data and attributes on Engage.
